annotations.category_path: Child Nutrition Programs / Other Spendinga / Estimated Budget Authority
annotations.variable_note: “Other Spending” includes the Special Milk Program, the Food Service Management Institute, Team Nutrition, coordinated review, computer support and processing, child nutrition grants for the Northern Mariana Islands and American Samoa, and other activities. It also includes discretionary projects funded in annual appropriation acts.
